title: AOP sister-event schedule context
purpose: Structured CWC handoff context for filling the viewer event calendar with RC-scale event sessions linked to map POIs.

source_brain_docs.use: Event mental model: Recon G6-style scale rally, Pro-Line By The Fire-style multi-day adventure, comp-class gate courses, and scale trials.
Event-layer data shape: stages, gates, mandatory skills sections, checkpoints, day loops, waypoints, registration, camping, vendors, parking, event status, and event-feature joins.
Viewer context: existing collapsible Event calendar card has Friday evening to night, Saturday morning to evening, and Sunday morning to mid-day windows.

data_caveats: Treat the sister-event schedules as vocabulary references, not a copied event template.
AOP's final schedule should be adjusted to confirmed site capacity, facilities, staffing, and AOP permission.
The 1010 Ellis Cove Road pavilion anchor is user-confirmed, but the FEMA footprint source itself remains raw context.
Activity hotspots are raw first-party GPX dwell evidence and should not be treated as trail authority.
The observed Saturday Afternoon Activity trail is publishable observed evidence today, not an official AOP trail system.

recommended_next_implementation_slice.task: Create an MVP event task card, likely brain/tasks/01_mvp/event_schedule_layer.md, to move this out of handoff.
Add event POI / route categories before coding.
Create website/data/aop_event_schedule.geojson or a PostGIS-backed export carrying event/session metadata and geometry.
Replace the generic viewer calendar rows with named schedule rows that can fly to linked POIs/routes/checkpoints.
Add a default-off event overlay toggle and Playwright coverage for schedule rendering, row-click camera movement, event POI visibility, and console cleanliness.
